messages.content:
Title: Diagnosis

Details:
The failure occurs during the extraction of entries from a CPIO archive in the test `testCpioUnarchive()`. The current bug report indicates that an EOF exception is thrown unexpectedly when unpacking a CPIO archive.

Inspecting the `CpioArchiveInputStream.getNextEntry()` method reveals that it delegates to `getNextCPIOEntry()`. The implementation of `getNextCPIOEntry()` attempts to read the magic number of the next entry from the input stream. It reads the first 2 bytes and compares against known magic values to determine the entry type and format, then continues reading accordingly. If the magic is unknown, it throws an IOException for "Unknown magic".

The `closeEntry()` method fully reads and discards any remaining entry bytes to position the stream for the next entry. If an entry ends prematurely or the EOF is reached unexpectedly before reading the full entry, the `read()` method in `CpioArchiveInputStream` will propagate the EOF condition or throw an IOException.

The test creates a CPIO archive with two files and subsequently attempts to extract them. The failure likely arises if the stream reading logic in `getNextCPIOEntry()` or during reading the entry data encounters an unexpected EOF. This can happen if the CPIO file header or data blocks are truncated or incorrectly formatted.

The recent bug reports about similar archive input stream implementations experiencing bugs when extracting entries due to improperly skipping datafields and unexpected EOF exceptions in TAR extraction support this conclusion. The root cause is probably a defect in reading or skipping over archive entry data or headers correctly, triggering premature EOF.

In summary, the bug arises because `getNextCPIOEntry()` or subsequent reading methods cannot handle certain inputs properly, causing them to throw unexpected EOF exceptions when reading or skipping entries from a CPIO archive.


Next, I will identify the best methods to potentially fix this issue.
org.apache.commons.compress.archivers.cpio.CpioArchiveInputStream.getNextCPIOEntry()
org.apache.commons.compress.archivers.cpio.CpioArchiveInputStream.read(byte[],int,int)
org.apache.commons.compress.archivers.cpio.CpioArchiveInputStream.closeEntry()

Based on the available information, provide the signatures of the most likely culprit methods for the bug. Your answer will be processed automatically, so make sure to only answer with the accurate signatures of all likely culprits (in `ClassName.MethodName(ArgType1, ArgType2, ...)` format), without commentary (one per line).
